components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-contrast affirmative action button with white fill and dark text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #ffffff; color: #09090b; padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); outline: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e4e4e7; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffffff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Subdued charcoal action button with razor border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #1c1c1f; color: #fafafa; padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid #27272a; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; outline: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #27272a; border-color: #3f3f46; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffffff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Pill Protected
components.description: High-contrast emerald indicator confirming active protection.
components.html: Protected
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-pill-safe { background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.35); color: #22c55e; }

components.name: Status Pill Locked
components.description: Signal red status badge indicating strict focus session lockout.
components.html: Focus Locked
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-pill-warn { background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.35); color: #ef4444; }

components.name: Switch Toggle
components.description: Minimal monochrome toggle switch with white knob.
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; display: inline-block; width: 36px; height: 20px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch input { opacity: 0; width: 0; height: 0; } .ds-slider { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: #27272a; border: 1px solid #3f3f46; border-radius: 9999px; transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 0.15s; } .ds-slider::before { position: absolute; content: ''; height: 14px; width: 14px; left: 2px; top: 2px; background: #a1a1aa; border-radius: 50%; transition: transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background 0.15s; } .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-slider { background: #18181b; border-color: #ffffff; } .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-slider::before { transform: translateX(16px); background: #ffffff; } .ds-switch input:focus-visible + .ds-slider { outline: 2px solid #ffffff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Countdown Circle
components.description: Signature tabular numeral countdown container with razor warning border.
components.css: .ds-countdown { width: 120px; height: 120px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid #ef4444; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 16px; margin: 0 auto; box-sizing: border-box; background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.05); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-countdown-num { font-size: 36px; font-weight: 700; color: #fafafa; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1; } .ds-countdown-label { font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #a1a1aa; margin-top: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
ShortStop is engineered as a precision cognitive barrier against algorithmic short-video doomscrolling. Its visual atmosphere is architectural, restrained, and unmistakably quiet. Rather than adopting the playful, pastel, or gamified aesthetics typical of consumer productivity extensions, ShortStop feels like high-grade laboratory equipment: dark obsidian planes, razor-sharp 1px borders, and pure white accents that command respect without shouting.

The interface prioritizes calmness, scanability, and spatial honesty. There are no decorative illustrations, celebratory confetti, or artificial pulsing indicators. Every visual element either clarifies system state or facilitates an intentional decision.
keyCharacteristics: Zero Decorative Slop: No gradient text, drop shadows used as halos, or artificial pulsing dots.
Monochrome Foundation: Built entirely from deep black, neutral dark charcoals, and calibrated zinc greys.
Strictly Functional Signaling: Pure white provides focal accentuation; crisp signal red and emerald green exist solely for functional warning/safe state differentiation.
Tabular Geometry: Timers and quotas utilize tabular figures to maintain physical visual stability during countdowns.

rules.name: The Monochromatic Dominance Rule
rules.body: The interface is ≥95% black, grey, and white. Color is forbidden from decorative accents, backgrounds, or branding flourishes.

rules.name: The Binary Signal Rule
rules.body: Red and Green are reserved strictly for safety and danger states. Neither may ever be used for decorative chips or non-status typography.

rules.name: The Tabular Clock Rule
rules.body: Any numeral that changes dynamically (seconds, minutes, percentages) must explicitly render with tabular-nums to eliminate layout jitter.

rules.name: The Flat-Surface Rule
rules.body: Cards and controls sit flush in their plane. Shadows exist solely on floating modal dialogs to establish layer isolation.

dos: Do maintain strict WCAG AA contrast (≥4.5:1 for body, ≥3:1 for headers) across both dark and light modes.
Do style browser surfaces (::selection, custom scrollbars, and :focus-visible outlines).
Do enforce tabular numbers (tabular-nums) on any counter, clock, or numerical metric.
Do provide @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) alternatives that neutralize transitions for motion-sensitive users.
donts: Don't use decorative pulsing dots or artificial status animations.
Don't introduce colorful backgrounds, brand gradients, or blue/indigo tints.
Don't use shame-based or patronizing language on blocked screens.
Don't allow text in circular progress or countdown containers to touch the outer border boundary.
